sources.title: 全球最大！辰亞「彰濱崙尾東三號海上型太陽能電站」完工
sources.locator: Article text on the Changhua Lunwei East No. 3 station
sources.note: The government-hosted page attributes its report to United Daily News and describes a separate 248 MW station as the world’s largest “offshore-type” solar power station. Its terminology and project type may differ from the Jiadong open-sea test, so it does not by itself settle the claim’s ranking.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and source checks located evidence for the Jiadong test project’s location and nature, but no reliable global ranking with a defined metric and comparison set. The ranking atom remains UNKNOWN.
The issuer’s statement about two MW-scale offshore demonstration projects is self-reported and does not establish a global site-size ranking.
The Jiadong capacity and non-generation details are reported by a secondary fact-checking source; the cited project material does not provide a global comparator.
“One of the largest” has no specified date, metric, or comparison set. Sources also use “offshore” for differing project types.
